name: DrillBlastPatternManager
tagline: Design, drill, charge and fire blasts with QA/QC tolerances, powder factor, exclusion zone and misfire register – one Power Apps component.
description: A complete drill and blast app for open-pit and underground mines: pattern design with a generator, drill records against design depth, charge mass and stemming per hole with tolerance checks, powder factor and explosive mass, a status board, exclusion-zone guards, firing sign-offs by role and a misfire register with all clear. Demo mode works the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen or model-driven form.
features: Hole plan coloured by state, depth or charge vs design
Depth, charge, stemming and powder-factor rules
Rule-checked lifecycle Design → Drilling → Charging → Ready to fire → Fired → Closed
Misfire register with make-safe and all clear
CSV export, grouping, bulk actions, undo
Outputs and events for Power Fx
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
